title: Core: SymbolInstance transform matrix operations
description: Unit tests for transform matrix operations on SymbolInstances. Create a SymbolInstance with x=10, y=20, scaleX=1.5, scaleY=2.0, rotation=45. Compute the affine matrix. Test that getTransformMatrix(instance) returns the correct [a,b,c,d,tx,ty] 2D affine matrix. Test matrix inversion and point transformation. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/transform-matrix.test.ts.
